about: Chapter 44 argues that a king must not be reviled by his people, since he is God's anointed and God rewards the good king with victory and a throne in heaven and on earth. It then turns to priests, who surpass the prophets and must fearlessly rebuke the king when they have seen his sins, as Samuel did Saul and Elijah Ahab, while the people are not to revile the clergy.

sentences.i: But if he is stubborn (?) against God, does no good, and does not walk in the straight way, God himself will do to him as he wishes: on earth he will shorten his days, and in the afterlife his dwelling will be the abode of Sheol, with the Devil;
sentences.n: ወእመሰ: ወ- 'and' + እመ 'if' + -ሰ (a contrastive enclitic, 'but if'). ተዐወሮ is a passive/reflexive stem (ተ-) with object suffix; the root is uncertain: perhaps from ዐወረ 'be blind' (?), so 'was blind/hardened toward', or 'opposed' (?); I read 'was hardened against', as in `l`. ወኢ ፡ ሖረ: the wordspace splits ኢ from ሖረ 'walked' (printing quirk; read ወኢሖረ). ፍኖት 'way', ርትዕት 'straight, right' (fem. adjective). ለሊሁ 'himself'. ይገብር 'does, will do' (imperfect, not subjunctive, which would be ይግበር); በከመ 'as, according as'; ፈቀደ 'wished'; ላዕሌሁ 'upon him'. ያሐጽጽ 'he makes short' (causative of ሐጸጸ). መዋዕሊሁ 'his days'. 'In the heavens' is odd here and must mean the next world; ማኅደረ ሲኦል 'dwelling-of Sheol' is a construct chain. ዲያብሎስ the Devil. Final ማኅደሩ 'his dwelling' resumes the clause.

sentences.i: It is not good for the people under a king to revile him, for he is God's requital (?);
sentences.n: እምሕዝብ: እም- 'from, by' + ሕዝብ 'people'; እለ 'who' (plural relative); እምታሕቴሁ 'from under him'. sentences.l: and the-people-of Christians-indeed, the-faithful, dwell in-peace without sickness and-suffering, without hatred and-constraint(?), with our-king so-and-so, lover-of God, while he-does-not-remove from-his-heart words-of righteousness and-faith, for-the-sake-of churches and-the-faithful; and his-enemies-too (are) subdued by-the-power-of cross-his to-Jesus Christ.
sentences.i: But the Christian people, the faithful, live in peace, without sickness or suffering, without hatred or constraint (?), together with our king, N., a lover of God, while he does not put away from his heart the words of righteousness and faith, for the sake of the churches and the faithful; and his enemies too are subdued by the power of the cross of Jesus Christ.
sentences.n: ሕዝበ ክርስቲያን 'people-of Christians', a construct chain; the verb ይነብሩ 'they dwell' (ነበረ). ማዕቀፍ is uncertain (?): from ዐቀፈ 'embrace, hold', perhaps 'oppression, restraint', or 'enclosure, siege' (?). እገሌ 'so-and-so', presumably a placeholder where the name of the reigning king is to be inserted when the text is read aloud. መፍቀሬ እግዚኣብሔር 'lover-of God' (agent noun of ፈቀረ + construct). ኢያአትት 'does not remove': the same verb as ወያአትት in chapter 27 (አአተተ; the stem is not well known (?)). ነገረ ጽድቅ 'word-of righteousness'; ሃይማኖት 'faith'; አብያተ ክርስቲያናት 'houses-of Christians', i.e. churches. ፀሩኒ ግሩራን: ፀሩኒ is ፀር 'enemy' + the suffix -ሁ (ፀሩ, 'his enemies', a collective) + -ኒ 'also'; the ending -ሩ cannot be a plural, so I read 'his' (the king's) rather than a bare 'enemies' (?). ግሩራን 'subdued' (passive participle of ገረረ, as ያገርር above) has the plural ending -ን. በኀይለ መስቀሉ ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ 'by the power of the cross of Jesus Christ' (the ለ- possessive again). The chapter ends with a run of ፨ marks.

glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢየኀፍሮ: ኀፍረ — not being ashamed of him (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሁ '3ms him', G, ḫ-f-r)
glossary.ኢያሀጒል: አሀጕለ — he does not lose, destroy (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative IV of ሀጕለ 'perish', h-g-l)
glossary.ኢያአትት: አአተተ — he does not remove, put away (?) (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect; as ወያአትት in ch. 27, the stem is not well known) (?)
glossary.ኢያፍርህከ: አፍርሀ — let it not frighten you (ኢ- + 3ms jussive + -ከ '2ms you', causative IV, f-r-h)
glossary.ኢይሕምይዎሙ: ሐመየ — let them not revile them (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive + -ሙ '3mp them', G, ḥ-m-y)
glossary.ኢገሠጾ: ገሠጸ — he did not rebuke him (ኢ- + 3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him', G, g-ś-ṣ)
glossary.እምልቡ: ልብ — from his heart (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምታሕቴሁ: ታሕት — from beneath him (እም- 'from' + ታሕቴ- + -ሁ '3ms him'; 'under his authority')
glossary.እምትካት: ትካት — from the foundation, from of old (?) (እም- 'from' + ትካት 'establishment', cf. ዘትካት in ch. 30; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.እምነቢያት: ነቢይ — than the prophets (እም- 'than, from' + plural ነቢያት; comparative)
glossary.እም፫: እም — from, out of, one of (preposition) + ፫ numeral 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three': 'out of three'
glossary.እኂዘ: አኀዘ — to grasp, to take hold of (infinitive, G, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ኦካህን: ካህን — O priest (interjection ኦ 'O' joined to the noun; vocative)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
glossary.ካህናትሰ: ካህን — priests indeed (plural ካህናት + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወሃይማኖት: ሃይማኖት — and faith, belief (ወ- 'and' + noun, f.)
glossary.ወለካህናት: ካህን — and to/for the priests (ወ- + ለ- + plural ካህናት)
glossary.ወሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and the people of (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'people of')
glossary.ወመሀሮ: መሀረ — and to teach (him), or 'and teach him!' (ወ- + infinitive, or 2ms imperative + -ሁ '3ms him'; G, m-h-r) (?)
glossary.ወማዕቀፍ: ማዕቀፍ — and constraint, restraint (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, perhaps from ዐቀፈ 'embrace, enclose'; or 'enclosure, siege'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወሠጠጠ: ሠጠጠ — and he tore, rent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ś-ṭ-ṭ)
glossary.ወሰብአ: ሰብእ — and men (ወ- + noun; construct 'men of' in ሰብአ ቤቱ 'his household')
glossary.ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበዲበ: ዲበ — and upon, on (ወ- 'and' + በ- + preposition)
glossary.ወበፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — and in joy, gladness (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + noun)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአንተኒ: አንተ — and you also (ወ- 'and' + 2ms independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኢ: ኢ — and not (ወ- 'and' + negative particle, written apart from its verb ሖረ)
glossary.ወኢመፍትው: መፍትው — and not fitting (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + adjective)
glossary.ወኢስደት: ስደት — and not persecution (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + noun)
glossary.ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወኢያገብኦ: አግብአ — and he does not deliver him up (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive + -ኦ '3ms him', causative IV of ገብአ 'enter', g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወኢገብረ: ገብረ — and he did not do/make (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወኤልያስኒ: ኤልያስ — and Elijah also (ወ- 'and' + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — and Israel indeed (ወ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወካህንሰ: ካህን — and the priest indeed (ወ- 'and' + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዘኢርእየሰ: ርእየ — and as for what he has not seen (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- 'what' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect + contrastive -ሰ, G, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ወያምዕዑ: አምዐ — and they anger, provoke (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative IV, ʾ-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወያረትዕ: አርትዐ — and he makes straight, establishes (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative IV, r-t-ʿ)
glossary.ወያነብሮ: አነበረ — and he seats him, sets him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሁ '3ms him', causative IV of ነበረ 'sit', n-b-r)
glossary.ወያገርር: አገረረ — and he subdues, brings under (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect/jussive, IV, g-r-r)
glossary.ወድኅረሰ: ድኅረ — and afterward indeed (ወ- 'and' + adverb/preposition + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወጌጋዮሙ: ጌጋይ — and their error, fault (ወ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወፀሩኒ: ፀር — and his enemies also (ወ- 'and' + ፀር + -ሁ '3ms his', ፀሩ, collective + enclitic -ኒ 'also'; or bare 'enemies') (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዖዝያንንጉሥ: ዖዝያን — Uzziah the king (proper name ዖዝያን + ንጉሥ written as one word)
glossary.ዘርእየ: ርእየ — what he saw (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘቦቱ: በ — who has (ዘ- relative + preposition በ + -ቱ '3ms'; ቦቱ 'in him', expressing possession: 'he who has')
glossary.ዘኢይክሉ: ክህለ — who are not able (ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘያበርህ: አብርሀ — which gives light, illumines (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative IV, b-r-h)
glossary.ዘይወቅሶ: ወቀሰ — who may reproach him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -ሁ '3ms him', G, w-q-s)
glossary.ዘገሠጽዎሙ: ገሠጸ — that they rebuked them (ዘ- 'that, the fact that' + 3mp perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', G, g-ś-ṣ; በእንተ ዘ- 'because')
glossary.የሐምዩ: ሐመየ — they revile (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-m-y)
glossary.ያሐጽጽ: አሐጸጸ — he shortens, diminishes (3ms imperfect/jussive, causative IV, ḥ-ṣ-ṣ)
glossary.ያነግሦ: አንገሠ — he makes him king, enthrones him (3ms imperfect + -ሁ '3ms him', causative IV, n-g-ś)
glossary.ያገርር: አገረረ — he subdues, brings under (3ms imperfect/jussive, IV, g-r-r; cf. ግሩር 'subject')
glossary.ይሕምይዎ: ሐመየ — that they revile him (3mp subjunctive + -ዎ '3ms him', G, ḥ-m-y)
glossary.ይኄይሱ: ኀየሰ — they are better, surpass (3mp imperfect, G, ḫ-y-s)
glossary.ይነብሩ: ነበረ — they live, dwell (3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ይኤብስ: ይኤብስ — a verb of stubbornness or wrongdoing, root unclear (?) (3ms imperfect (?); cf. ይኤብሱ, ch. 42)
glossary.ይእኅዙ: አኀዘ — that they may grasp, hold (3mp subjunctive, G, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ይገሥጾ: ገሠጸ — he rebukes him (3ms imperfect ይገሥጽ + -ሁ '3ms him', G, g-ś-ṣ)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይፈትን: ፈተነ — he tests, tries, judges (3ms imperfect, G, f-t-n)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ገሠጾ: ገሠጸ — he rebuked him (3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him', G, g-ś-ṣ)
glossary.ገሥጾ: ገሠጸ — to rebuke (infinitive ገሥጾ), or 'rebuke him!' (2ms imperative + -ሁ '3ms him'), G, g-ś-ṣ (?)
glossary.ገሥጾቶ: ገሠጸ — to rebuke him, rebuking him (infinitive ገሥጾ- + 3ms suffix, G, g-ś-ṣ)
glossary.ግሩራን: ግሩር — subdued, subjected (plural passive participle/adjective, from ገረረ)
glossary.ጻድቃኒሁ: ጻድቅ — righteous one (plural ጻድቃን + -ሁ '3ms his': 'his righteous ones')
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፄወ: ጼው — salt (?) (noun, accusative ጼወ; spelled here with the ፀ-series ፄ, a variant of ጼው) (?)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
glossary.፵፬: ፵፬ — numeral 44, chapter number; spoken አርብዓ ወአርባዕቱ (ʾärbəʿa wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'forty-four' (numeral)
